notes: Figures were unavailable, so Fig. 2 (overhead), Fig. 3-5 (Cons/Pass@k, SLOT, lambda/N/k ablations) were judged from text only. The skill orders the literature check after the five reports are drafted; one model wrote all reports in one context, so I ran the searches before writing the final file, but the reviewers' judgments were formed from the paper alone and only the Domain addendum uses the search results. Several related_search.py queries were refused for having 5 concept words (hyphenated terms count as separate words), which the skill text does not warn about; the 4-word limit is easy to hit. A work directory could not be created via mkdir without approval, so literature-check files were written directly to the results directory. The 'recent preprint' rule neatly handled the closest prior work (EM-INF, 4 months before cutoff): it is discussed but did not lower any score. The skill's pool-position bands and Overall definitions are mildly in tension: Overall 3 is both 'borderline reject' and 'typical rejected submission', so R4's pool position 54 (top of the 42-54 band) was the hardest calibration choice. The EIC's own pool position is not an input to the script; I stated 50 in the meta-review.
